slide2_error1.headline: {H}漏冠词{/H}
slide2_error1.problem_desc: 可数单数前必须有 a/an/the
slide2_error1.card_body: I want to be {Y}∅ doctor{/Y} because I love {Y}∅ science{/Y}.

slide3_error2.headline: {H}the{/H} 滥用
slide3_error2.card_body: {Y}The{/Y} people love {Y}the{/Y} music and {Y}the{/Y} sports very much.

slide4_error3.headline: {H}a / an{/H} 不分
slide4_error3.card_body: I saw {Y}a elephant{/Y} and {Y}an university{/Y} on my trip.

slide5_fix.headline: 立刻{H}冠词无错{/H}！
slide5_fix.card_body: Countable singular = {Y}a/an/the{/Y}, specific thing = {Y}the{/Y}, vowel sound = {Y}an{/Y}.
